findings.title: uv run pytest exited 1 on an unrelated root-environment permissions test
findings.evidence: 04-verification+gate.txt: 1 failed, 1899 passed; test/test_run_review_checks.py::test_an_unwritable_worktree_parent_is_refused DID NOT RAISE Refused; run under /tmp/pytest-of-root; diff touches only two docs/04-decisions files
findings.consequence: A non-zero verification command stays on record; baseline not run to confirm it is pre-existing
findings.minimal_fix: Confirm the same failure on base or rerun as a non-root user, and record it as pre-existing

findings.title: ADR-016 superseded while ADR-031 is still draft/proposed
findings.evidence: ADR-016 status: superseded; ADR-031 status: draft, 'Proposed; awaiting the owner's ratification'; open item 5
findings.consequence: Until ratification, dependents point at a superseded record that still describes the shipped workbench
findings.minimal_fix: Owner ratifies, or reverts both front matters in one commit, as the ADR states

findings.title: Keep verdict on decision 1 understates layout shape and stored-geometry changes
findings.evidence: ADR-031 decisions 5 and 8 change the panels shape and add stored grid_tracks; the kept-versus-changed table lists decision 1 as Keep except one clause
findings.consequence: A reader of the table alone could miss that decision 8 touches the persistence posture; the supersede is meant to read as structural only
findings.minimal_fix: Add a line to the kept-versus-changed section saying grid_tracks is the one place stored selections gain geometry, pointing to open item 1

findings.title: ADR spans decisions beyond the slot model
findings.evidence: Decisions 7 (session ownership), 8 (geometry), 9 (maximize/collapse) and 10 (migration) in a 533-line record
findings.consequence: More for the owner to ratify in one record; all are flagged as open items

notes: Shadow judge (gating: false), same brief as the gating reviewer plus the runner manifest; no checkout. Its F03 is carried to the builder's fix round alongside the gating findings. Evidence file is the judge's final message transcribed by the coordinator (the judge has no write tool); findings and JSON verbatim, narrative condensed.
